author: djpooria
quote: Disappointing, the biggest betrayal to the gaming world imposed on gamers around the world by the production company and its supporters. The game is at best just an update from version 5 that has lost all of the original and rooted features of the game. Gambling on the type of storytelling and removing core elements and replacing them with pointless tasks. In terms of graphic design, it is a generation behind the current titles, and the game engine's graphics are completely outdated. I thought the 60fps capability for 10th generation consoles was another gamble that Rockstar took, and it definitely hurt the game because running the game at such low quality at 30fps made everything **** characterization has also completely fallen, and the type of story narrative creates a sense of shame and slavery in the player instead of a sense of pride. In total, thirteen years of time for this series of mistakes is completely unforgivable, and the results will be shown to you by the gamers themselves in the future.
